payload.why_choose_content:
Pros of the NMIMS Online

  • Best University for online degree: NMIMS Online has received the Education Innovation Awards, Entrepreneur India (2022), for the best university offering an online degree.

payload.hero_description: NMIMS is a renowned private deemed university in India that offers fully valid online learning undergraduate and postgraduate programs. The institution follows the motto of "Upskill, Upgrade, Uninterrupted," and to date, NMIMS has empowered over 185,000 students. An online degree pursued from NMIMS Online is valued by top employers and comes with several benefits, including integrated industry and academic best practices, highly acclaimed career-led courses, and practical learning opportunities through the NMIMS Online digital campus.
payload.exam_content:
The NMIMS online courses examination process is similar for both UG and PG programs. The exams are conducted through an online proctored platform that allows students to appear for the examinations from any corner of the globe; they only need a good internet connection, a laptop, and a working webcam.

The NMIMS online examinations follow an evaluation method of IA + TEE, which stands for Internal Assessment + Term End Examinations.
payload.about_content:
The Narsee Monjee Institute for Management Studies, abbreviated as NMIMS, was established in 1981. Since then, NMIMS has been among the top institutions in India offering quality education matching global standards. Simultaneously, to make higher education more convenient and accessible, NMIMS initiated its Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE) in 1994, also known as NMIMS Online CDOE.

The NMIMS Online (CDOE) offers several online undergraduate, postgraduate, and MBA (WX) programs. The NMIMS online courses are completely online and delivered through virtual learning platforms that consist of e-books, journals, and lecture transcripts with 24*7 access. Choosing NMIMS online courses is a good choice as it has a vast network of 82,000+ alumni across the world, 40+ years of legacy, 157,000+ lives transformed, and 20,000+ recruiters shaping dream careers for students.

To ensure a promising future for enrolled students and working professionals, the NMIMS Online course includes coveted faculty with nurturing leaders. Meanwhile, the course structure follows a KSA (Knowledge Skill Aptitude) format that develops the industry relevant skillset among professionals for workplace success and career advancement.
payload.emi_content:
To lessen the financial burden on students and working professionals willing to acquire an online degree from NMIMS Online CDOE, the institute provides several financial assistance options, including loans, no-cost EMI, and scholarship facilities. The NMIMS online EMI assistance is available for a tenure of 3, 6, 9, or 12 months. The loan and EMI facility is available through the credit cards of the following banks:

  • HDFC Bank
  • ICICI Bank
  • Axis Bank
  • Citi Bank
  • Standard Chartered Bank
  • HSBC Bank
  • Kotak Mahindra Bank

A scholarship of 20% on the program fee is also available at the NMIMS Online CDOE for the armed forces, defence personnel, and their immediate family.

payload.admission_steps:
NMIMS Online Admission Process

Candidates who are interested in pursuing an online degree from NMIMS Online are required to first qualify for the eligibility criteria of their chosen program prior to beginning the following NMIMS online admission process:

  1. Visit the official website of the university and register online at online.nmims.edu.
  2. Fill out the NMIMS online application form with the required information.
  3. Pay the mentioned NMIMS online application fee.
  4. Submit the supporting documents along with the NMIMS online application form.
  5. Pay the NIMIMS course fee via a demand draft in favour of "SVKM's NMIMS" payable at Mumbai.
  6. Wait for confirmation from the university end. Once the application is confirmed, the university will generate a student number for you.

Important Notes:

  • The NMIMS online application fee is INR 1,200 /-.
  • The documents required for the NMIMS online admission process are academic documents, a photo ID, and passport-size photographs.

faqs.question: Is an NMIMS online degree valid?
faqs.answer: Yes, every online degree course offered at NMIMS Online is UGC-recognized, making it completely valid.

faqs.question: What are the fees for NMIMS online courses?
faqs.answer: The average fee structure for every online course at NMIMS is between INR 18,000 /- to INR 55,000 /- per semester, whereas for the executive courses it is approximately INR 4,00,000 /- for the complete course.

faqs.question: Is the NMIMS online MBA good?
faqs.answer: Yes, the NMIMS online MBA is one of the most prominent online MBA courses in India, and the majority of students enroll in the particular course every year.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for the NMIMS online MBA?
faqs.answer: Any candidate with a valid bachelor's degree with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks is eligible for the NMIMS online MBA.

faqs.question: Which is better, Manipal or NMIMS for online MBA?
faqs.answer: Both universities are UGC-recognized, but there are different specialization options at each institution. The university with the specializations as per your requirement is considered to be better. However, it can NMIMS Online MBA or a Manipal Online MBA.

payload.placement_content:
NMIMS Online courses are placement-assisted, and the placement cell remains active throughout the course duration to provide continuous guidance. NMIMS Online course graduates are entitled to a plethora of job opportunities with the 500+ hiring partners of the institution.

There are several career services available under the NMIMS Online Placement Cell, namely:

  • Assessment of cognitive abilities and skills.
  • Resume and CV development with social media profiling.
  • Guidance from NMIMS Online career coaches.
  • Interview preparation.
  • Access to job opportunities with a dedicated job portal.

NMIMS Online has collaborated with various MNCs, business organizations, and start-ups across several industries that actively recruit skilled professionals from the university. Some major recruiters of NMIMS Online graduates are:

  • Indiamart
  • Wockhardt
  • Zalaris
  • Milkbasket
  • Tata
  • Shopx

facts.fact_description: NMIMS online courses offer a rich and holistic learning experience with its virtual learning environment and on-campus immersion program & bootcamp.
The institution provides access to 1 Connect, a tool designed to assist students with personalized guidance and support by providing a timely resolution to their queries.
The career services provide a 6 month access to job portals like IIMJobs, Updazz, and Hirist.
NMIMS Online provides an online MBA and an online MBA (WX), which is an executive program designed primarily for working professionals (mid-senior professionals).
The NMIMS Online courses follow experimental learning with a plethora of specializations, real-world case studies, business simulation projects, and hands-on industry experiences.
The "Students Zone" of NMIMS Online can be accessed through a phone or a laptop, allowing students to study anytime, anywhere.

reviews.review_text: I was literally very confused while looking for online MBA but my experience with NMIMS online MBA was seamless and i really enjoyed it and the best thing i found about them is their program validity extension.
My colleague suggested me about th NMIMS online and currently my second sem is going and so far I am satisfied with their academic deliverables.

Its been a year since i completed my online BBA from NMIMS and with their placement assistance I am now an MNC with a decent job role. I will surely enroll for their online MBA this year for better opportunities.
I got placed with NMIMS online placement cell guidance and i really recommend it to everyone out there as their faculty members are really supportive.
